platform.title: Platform panel
platform.noPlanNote: With no plan every feature is on and nothing is limited.
platform.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text by hand.

login.title: Sign in to the platform panel
login.subtitle: This sign-in is separate from the sign-in of the companies.

companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Every company that uses the software.
companies.name: Name

create.title: New company
create.codeHint: What the customer types to sign in. Lowercase letters, digits and "-".
create.name: Company name
create.adminPasswordHint: Leave empty to generate one, shown once. At least 10 characters.
create.done: The company "{name}" was created with the code {code}.
create.once: This password is shown only now. Give it to the customer at once. At the first sign-in the administrator can keep it or change it.
create.passwordYours: You gave the password yourself; it is not shown here.
create.noAdmin: No administrator was created. Make one with "php artisan user:create admin --tenant={code}".

detail.suspendedNote: This company is suspended: nobody can sign in to it, but its data is untouched.
detail.graceNote: The subscription has ended and the company is in its grace period (until {date}). Everything works, with a warning.
detail.expiredNote: The subscription and the grace period are over: the company can only view and export its data.
detail.planNote: A change of plan applies at once. To change one feature or limit for this company only, use the command tenant:override.
detail.reissueMessage: A new key makes the current one stop working. Continue?
detail.revokeMessage: The current key stops working for good. Continue?
detail.overridesNote: Display only. Changed with the command tenant:override.
detail.reasonHint: At least 5 characters. Written to the change log.
detail.suspendMessage: Until it is activated again nobody can sign in to this company. No data is deleted.

license.once: This key is shown only now and is not kept in the system. Copy it and store it safely now. If it is lost you have to issue a new one.

renew.title: Renew the subscription of "{name}"
renew.noEnd: The current subscription has no end.
renew.monthsHint: Counted from the current end if it is still ahead, otherwise from today.
renew.dateHint: Any date is allowed, to shorten or to correct.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: What each plan includes.
plans.note: Plans are made or changed with the command plan:create.

audit.title: Change log
audit.subtitle: Every change of companies, subscriptions and keys is recorded here.

err.notAvailable: The panel is not available on this server (it works only in multi-company mode).
err.invalid_code: The code must be 2 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and "-".
err.invalid_database: The database name is not valid.
err.invalid_admin: The first administrator is not valid: check the username, the full name and the password (at least 10 characters).
err.central_not_ready: The central database is not ready; run php artisan tenant:setup.
err.company_exists: A company with this code already exists.
err.database_in_use: This database belongs to another company.
err.database_exists: A database with this name already exists.
err.renew_choice: Give either the number of months or the end date, not both.
err.invalid_months: The months must be between 1 and 60.
err.reason_required: A reason is required (at least 5 characters).
err.no_active_license: This company has no active key.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts. Try again later.
